_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Laafi bɛɛliga kɔnɔ

📖 KALO KƆNƆ:
• I kɔnɔ {start_chips} kɔpɛ
• Kɔkɔɔ kɔnɔ 52 kɔpɛ (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• I jɛɛri laafi bɛɛliga kɔnɔ dɛɛri (sɔ)
• Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ Ultimate Texas Hold'em kɔnɔ: i pɔsɛ ANTE ɛɛri BLIND kɔpɛ, i rɛsɛɛ 2 kɔpɛ kɔnɔ, i dɛsɛɛ PLAY kɔpɛ kɔnɔ, i rɛsɛɛ kɔmɛ kɔpɛ ɛɛri i pɔsɛ i sɔgɔ kɔpɛ kɔnɔ dɛɛri kɔpɛ
• Laafi kɔnɔ i rɛsɛɛ 0 kɔpɛ ɛɛri i sɔgɔ kɔpɛ kɔnɔ dɛɛri kɔpɛ (LOSS) ɛɛri i kɔnɔ 1000 kɔnɔ kɔpɛ (WIN)

💰 KƆPƐ KƆNƆ:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} kɔpɛ kɔnɔ
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} kɔpɛ kɔnɔ
• PLAY: Optional kɔpɛ kɔnɔ. Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, i pɔsɛ ONLY ONE kɔpɛ kɔnɔ: (${ante4} if done at PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} if done at FLOP, or ${ante} if done at RIVER. Can also fold at river, giving up on the hand, and making no bet.)

🎴 KƆPƐ KƆNƆ:
• I rɛsɛɛ 2 kɔpɛ kɔnɔ (i kɔpɛ kɔnɔ)
• Dɛɛri rɛsɛɛ 2 kɔpɛ kɔnɔ (hidden from you)
• 5 kɔmɛ kɔpɛ kɔnɔ dɛɛri kɔpɛ
• Kɔmɛ kɔpɛ kɔnɔ rɛsɛɛ progressively kɔnɔ kɔnɔ

🏆 DƐƐRI KƆNƆ:
• Dɛɛri pɔsɛ at least a PAIR (2 kɔpɛ kɔnɔ same rank) kɔnɔ, using the 2 kɔpɛ kɔnɔ dɛɛri kɔpɛ ɛɛri the 5 kɔmɛ kɔpɛ.
• Dɛɛri kɔnɔ affects the kɔpɛ outcomes, as will be explained later.

🎮 KƆNƆ KƆNƆ & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) or [check]
  • [4x]: Place ${ante4} PLAY kɔpɛ, rɛsɛɛ first 3 kɔmɛ kɔpɛ
  • [check]: No additional kɔpɛ, rɛsɛɛ first 3 kɔmɛ kɔpɛ

📋 FLOP:
  • If 4x kɔpɛ placed: Only [skip] available (auto-rɛsɛɛ last 2 kɔmɛ kɔpɛ)
  • If no 4x kɔpɛ: [2x] (${ante2}) or [check]
  • [2x]: Place ${ante2} PLAY kɔpɛ, rɛsɛɛ last 2 kɔmɛ kɔpɛ
  • [check]: No additional kɔpɛ, rɛsɛɛ last 2 kɔmɛ kɔpɛ

📋 RIVER:
  • If 4x or 2x kɔpɛ placed: Only [skip] available (auto-kɔnɔ to showdown)
  • If no prior PLAY kɔpɛ: [1x] (${ante}) or [fold]
  • [1x]: Place ${ante} PLAY kɔpɛ, kɔnɔ to showdown
  • [fold]: Give up hand, lose ANTE ɛɛri BLIND kɔpɛ

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • All kɔpɛ rɛsɛɛ ɛɛri evaluated
  • Best 5-kɔpɛ hand from 7 kɔpɛ (2 kɔpɛ kɔnɔ + 5 kɔmɛ kɔpɛ)
  • Kɔpɛ settled according to payout rules

💎 KƆPƐ PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE KƆPƐ:
  • Dɛɛri doesn't qualify: PUSH (kɔpɛ returned)
  • Dɛɛri qualifies ɛɛri you win: 1:1 payout (kɔpɛ + winnings)
  • Dɛɛri qualifies ɛɛri you lose: kɔpɛ lost
  • Tie: PUSH (kɔpɛ returned)

📊 BLIND KƆPƐ:
  • Unaffected by dɛɛri qualification
  • You win: kɔpɛ returned ɛɛri additional payout based on your hand strength
  • You lose: kɔpɛ lost
  • Tie: PUSH (kɔpɛ returned)

📊 BLIND KƆPƐ PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: No additional payout

📊 PLAY KƆPƐ:
  • Unaffected by dɛɛri qualification
  • Direct comparison: Your best hand vs Dɛɛri's best hand
  • You win: 1:1 payout (kɔpɛ + winnings)
  • You lose: kɔpɛ lost
  • Tie: PUSH (kɔpɛ returned)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 of same suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 consecutive kɔpɛ of same suit
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kɔpɛ of same rank
  4. Full House: 3 of a kind + 2 of a kind
  5. Flush: 5 kɔpɛ of same suit
  6. Straight: 5 consecutive kɔpɛ
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kɔpɛ of same rank
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs of different ranks
  9. One Pair: 2 kɔpɛ of same rank
  10. High Card: Highest kɔpɛ wins

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] or [play bet 4x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY kɔpɛ
• [2x] or [play bet 2x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY kɔpɛ
• [1x] or [play bet 1x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY kɔpɛ
• [check] or [c]: Check (no additional kɔpɛ)
• [fold] or [f]: Fold (give up hand)
• [skip] or [s]: Skip to next phase (when no action needed)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Strong starting hands (pairs, high kɔpɛ) often justify 4x kɔpɛ
• Consider dɛɛri qualification - weak hands may push if dɛɛri doesn't qualify
• BLIND kɔpɛ can be very profitable with strong hands (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Watch your kɔpɛ stack! If it goes to 0 or below at start of round, you lose.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE ɛɛri BLIND kɔpɛ are mandatory every round
• PLAY kɔpɛ are optional ɛɛri strategic
• Make sure you input the correct action, ɛɛri only one action at a time.
